context: Vercel Next.js middleware authorization bypass via the x-middleware-subrequest header. CVSS 9.1, NOT in CISA KEV. Connection attempts this period, down 15% from 1,682,116 in the 2026-09-28 brief. 1,088 to 4,077 malicious IPs each full day, still more than twice the 30 August level. Persistent.

Hikvision IP camera command injection. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 10 January 2022. Connection attempts this period, up from 56,748 in the 2026-09-28 brief. 94.183.174.99 (AS51396, first seen 21 September) sent 208,070, 92%, so the rise rests on one host.

Oracle WebLogic Server T3 deserialization, unauthenticated code execution. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 08 September 2022. Connection attempts this period, 7.2 times the 25,933 in the 2026-09-28 brief. Seven heavy hosts on AS396982 sent 76%, each paired with Cisco Smart Install enumeration at matching counts. Intensifying.

Sophos Firewall user portal and web administration authentication bypass reaching code execution. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 31 March 2022. Connection attempts this period, down 28% from 130,444 in the 2026-09-28 brief. Declining; separate from the Sophos VPN portal spray in Finding 3.

Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway unauthenticated command execution via a crafted login request to /nf/auth/doAuthentication.do. CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV since 27 September 2026 (federal deadline 30 September, passed). Connection attempts on the GreyNoise behavior this period, up from 79 in the 2026-09-28 brief. Daily stream: 9 to 12 malicious IPs a day from 01 October; 66.42.100.63 sent 34,811 (two thirds). Lead finding.

CitrixBleed 2, NetScaler memory overread in the same login handler. CVSS 7.5, in CISA KEV since 10 July 2025 with known ransomware campaign use. Connection attempts this period, up from 1,030 in the 2026-09-28 brief. The rise largely reflects CVE-2026-88771 requests: 133 of the 147 IPs on that behavior also carried this one. Count the two as one NetScaler event.

Mesop unauthenticated Python execution via the /exec-py endpoint. CVSS 9.8, NOT in CISA KEV. Connection attempts this period, up from 3,814 in the 2026-09-28 brief. Runs alongside the Next.js bypass attempts.

AS48090, Netherlands. 65 active hosts, down from 75, running SSH credential attacks. Combined connection attempts for the range this period. Carried since the 2026-07-06 brief. Resolve each member on its own GreyNoise record before any block; key the durable control on the SSH Bruteforcer tag.

AS202412, Germany. GoogleBot Pretender connection attempts from the range this period, about half the behavior's 2,784,589 corpus-wide. Forged search engine crawler identity used for environment and sensitive file harvesting. Verify crawler identity against Google's published ranges and key the control on the GoogleBot Pretender tag; resolve members individually rather than blocking the range.

AS208137, Germany. 39 active hosts, down from 51, harvesting environment and Git configuration files. Combined connection attempts for the range this period. Carried since the 2026-06-22 brief. Classifications vary across members; resolve each before blocking.

Corpus-wide connection attempts this period. Shared by BytePlus (AS150436) hosts 163.7.11.121, last seen 01 October, and 163.7.11.91, first seen the same day, both forging Googlebot. One host replaced by another; match on all four fields.

Corpus-wide connection attempts carrying this JA4T this period. Presented by RDP crawling and credential attack hosts 62.164.177.54, 192.253.248.251 and 213.177.179.195, which ran 2,566,397 crawler attempts between them. A hunting pivot for inbound RDP negotiations, never a block key.

Carried only by the four core Sophos VPN portal spray hosts (5.181.86.88, 5.181.86.148, 141.98.83.34, 193.29.13.186), all classified malicious. GreyNoise first saw three of the four on 14 September; the fourth, 5.181.86.88, has been active since 2021. All but 31 of these connection attempts went to /api/v1/vpnportal/login. Finding 3.

The distributed half of the Sophos VPN portal spray: 4,441 IPs, led by commercial VPN exits, 99.8% of these connection attempts to /api/v1/vpnportal/login, about 260 per IP. Group hits by destination account. Finding 3.
Corpus-wide connection attempts from 1,538 IPs. The five NetScaler hosts in Finding 1 account for 49,668 (57%). Broad on its own: pair with POSTs to /nf/auth/doAuthentication.do carrying ${IFS}.

Citrix NetScaler Gateway authentication endpoint targeted by CVE-2026-88771 exploitation attempts. 66.42.100.63 sent all 34,816 of its connection attempts to this path, and 34,811 carried ${IFS}. Alert on POSTs here carrying shell metacharacters. Finding 1.

NetScaler webshell path, tagged by GreyNoise as Citrix NetScaler LogonPoint Webshell Command Execution Attempt. GreyNoise tagged 6,348 requests from four IPs as webshell attempts, 6,038 of them to webshell paths such as this one. 5,126 of the tagged requests arrived on 30 September. File names vary: alert on x.php, and on .pl, .php or .html files whose names begin Nx_ or nx_ (for example Nx_2271.pl, Nx_zD.php, nx_verify.php, nx_proof.pl), under /vpn/, /vpn/theme/, /vpn/bookmark/ and /logon/LogonPoint/, matched case-insensitively; key the alert on the tag as well. A file at this path on your own appliance warrants investigation. Finding 1.
